# nukadoko

Typed Gherkin / step contracts with tool-measured step records. Scenarios can fail statically before run; acceptance freezes a green run. Declaration (contracts, `mutates`) is separate from observation (what the tool recorded).

It is not an untyped free-form agent runner, and it is not a substitute for human sign-off of accept.

Agent skills: [skills/acceptance/SKILL.md](skills/acceptance/SKILL.md), [skills/migration/SKILL.md](skills/migration/SKILL.md). Each entry says when to use it and which `references/` file beside it holds the procedure. `nuka skill` prints the skills directory.

Installed package: `node_modules/nukadoko/skills/...` (this file at `node_modules/nukadoko/llms.txt`).

## Commands

- `nuka init` — project setup with self-check
- `nuka steps` / `nuka describe <name>` / `nuka scaffold <name>` — vocabulary and stubs
- `nuka check [feature]` — static checks before run
- `nuka do <name>` / `nuka run <feature..>` — execute under contracts; records on stdout
- `nuka accept <feature>` — freeze the last green run as an acceptance record
- `nuka harvest <step-record-ids..>` — draft a feature from `do` record ids
- `nuka session` / `nuka clean` / `nuka tend` — sessions, cleanup, rot signals
- `nuka mcp-tools` — MCP tool list when the host needs tools instead of CLI

Prefer `check` before `run`. Do not treat agent narrative as the step record.
